title: Same person under two employee IDs
why: A rehire or import may have created a second record, splitting pay and history.
fix: Confirm with HR and merge the records.

title: No cost centre
why: Pay cost cannot be charged to the right budget.
fix: Add the cost centre for the department.

title: Salary outside the band for the level
why: Often a typing error, and it distorts pay analysis.
fix: Check against the contract. If correct, record the approved exception.

title: Work email shared by two employees
why: System sign-in and notifications can reach the wrong person.
fix: Give each person a unique address.

title: Active employee with no manager
why: Approvals and reviews have nowhere to go.
fix: Assign the correct manager.

title: Reporting line loops back on itself
why: Nobody at the top of this chain, so org charts and approval routing fail.
fix: Correct the manager on at least one person in the loop.

title: Work email format is invalid
why: Messages and account creation will fail.
fix: Correct the address.

title: Hire date cannot be read
why: The value is not a real date, so reports drop this person.
fix: Correct it from the contract.

title: Leaving date before hire date
why: Tenure is negative and turnover reports break.
fix: Correct whichever date is wrong.

title: Marked active after the leaving date
why: This person may still be paid or keep system access.
fix: Confirm the status and close the record if they have left.

title: Fixed-term contract with no end date
why: The contract can expire with nobody alerted.
fix: Add the end date from the contract.

title: Manager ID does not exist
why: The reporting line is broken, so org charts and approvals fail.
fix: Assign a valid manager.

title: Terminated with no leaving date
why: Turnover cannot be placed in the right month.
fix: Enter the leaving date.

title: Working time outside 0 to 1
why: Pay and full-time-equivalent reporting are distorted.
fix: Correct the working-time fraction.

title: Contract type not on the approved list
why: Contract reporting and legal end-date tracking miss this person.
fix: Choose an approved contract type.

title: No hire date
why: Tenure, leave and headcount trends cannot be calculated.
fix: Enter the date from the contract.

title: Same employee ID on more than one row
why: Headcount and payroll feeds count this person twice.
fix: Find which row is correct and remove the other at source.

title: Listed as their own manager
why: Self-approval bypasses a basic control.
fix: Assign a different manager.

title: Reports to someone who has left
why: Requests go to a person who is no longer there.
fix: Move this employee to a current manager.

title: Under 16 on the hire date
why: Almost certainly a wrong birth date or hire date.
fix: Check against an identity document.

title: Active before the start date
why: Headcount is overstated until the person actually joins.
fix: Set the status to pending until the start date.
